about: The equations sheet of the inked script (topo/inkfig.js), generated by tools/dev/heptapod_equations.mjs. chosen and the inline literals are the debt: each is to be derived from physics or the grammar, or fitted by a stated objective on held-out sentences (Luis, 2026-11-18).

constants.name: S
constants.source: the film masks are 3300 px; the suite measures ours at the same size

constants.name: R_CANVAS
constants.source: film.md 5.2: R over canvas, median 0.365

constants.name: W_RING
constants.source: fitted 2026-11-18 with PRESS_FLOOR on the pod's 126 rings to the film's carrier (w_med 0.051 R and w_cv 0.709 inside the film's p10 to p90) while rings sharing no word are no more alike than the film's single masses (0.717 against 0.722, ring included); held out: F4-P9. Before: 0.05, 0.06, 0.09 by eye

constants.name: PRESS_FLOOR
constants.source: fitted with W_RING (2026-11-18): the film's carrier thins and swells with no relation to its masses (F4-P2 missed), so its unevenness is the hand's; 0.45 (an inline literal until 0.6) to 0.2

constants.name: C_REF
constants.source: the unit of a clause's ink: corpus B's mean node ink, 1.511 over 632 nodes (2026-11-18), so a clause of mean nodes keeps NODE_DEG per node

constants.name: E_STATE
constants.source: first value: a resting hand gathers the pool to 0.6 of its arc, the area kept

constants.name: TURN_CELL
constants.source: first value: a radical's word turns a thread at most 3 units, 0.5 radians; three radicals up to about 1.5, the range 0.3.1's turning noise spanned

constants.name: TREMOR
constants.source: first value, a quarter of the turning noise it replaces on threads that carry a word
